items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: My teacher in Bordentown, New Jersey, Professor Valentine, who happened to be a friend of W.C. Handy's, taught me theory and harmony and counterpoint before I ever picked up an instrument.

ctx.x: time I consider a stroke of luck, because I just happened to be in the right place, and they needed a bass player who can read, and fortunately, I could read anything they'd put up. I always... I could read before I could play. My teacher in Bordentown, New Jersey, Professor Valentine, who happened to be a friend of W.C. Handy's, taught me theory and harmony and counterpoint before I ever picked up an instrument. So I was fortunate in that way. I knew the keyboard, too.
You mentioned back earlier that you had gone to school with and played in the same band with Carl Warwick.
